Alex —

Great, thanks for the specifics. I sketched a quick comparison (numbers rounded):

Option A — Staged add-on (fastest go-live):
- 120 seats added now as an add-on, billed monthly at on-demand rate for first 3 months.
- One-time smoothing credit equal to 25% of first month add-on invoice (applied as account credit across next 2 invoices).
- No co-term; renewal remains May 1.
- Effective incremental discount on the 120 seats: ~5% over 12 months (because of credit).

Option B — Early commit (co-schedule on renewal):
- Commit the 120 seats as a 12-month tranche starting May 1.
- If committed before Apr 15, we can extend a 10% incremental discount on the new tranche (requires amended SOW and updated PO).
- Billing will be annualized on May 1 (one invoice for the committed capacity), with standard payment terms.

Option C — Hybrid split:
- 80 seats converted to the May-term committed band; 40 kept on-demand for burst.
- We can offer a 7% discount on the committed portion if accepted before Apr 15 + a one-time $8k onboarding credit.

Attached is quote_v2.pdf with the line-item math and a short note on implementation routing. A couple of conditions: any discount above 10% needs approval from revenue ops; credits require a signed amendment before the new invoices generate.

If the finance team wants to avoid large one-off cash outlays, Option B is the cleanest (moves the spend into the renewal invoice and gives the deepest percent discount). If you need the seats live earlier, Option C hits balance.

Call confirmed for Wed 3/24 10am PT. I'll include a quick deck slide so Olivia has the options laid out.

Ben
